description.default: T&C Manager validates a completed remediation action (BR-008, FR-023). Records an Approved or Rejected sign-off; a Rejected sign-off requires notes and returns the action to the adviser. Enforces the transition guard, optimistic concurrency and idempotency, and writes an immutable Audit Event.
